note: Per-dish memory hooks for §0b. 36 authored+adversarially-PASSED by the dish-memory-hooks workflow (wkrh2rg08); 5 hand-authored to fill verifier-id gaps (french-fries, chicken-sausage, fennel-salami, bigoli) + the 1 REVISE (oysters invented 'horseradish snap' — fixed to official garnishes). Every hook grounded ONLY in official name/components/description — no invented menu facts. Apply additively to src/data.js foods as memoryHook, then `node tools/build_app_data.mjs`.

hooks.french-fries: Shoestring fries, salted, dipped in garlic aioli — three words, the whole plate.
hooks.hummus-chips: Hummus becomes a crispy chip; preserved lemon shines on top.
hooks.garlic-bread: Cheese curds wrapped in bread, basted in garlic butter, fried golden.
hooks.cashews: Cashews boiled in vinegar, salted and crystallized — a chip's crunch without the chip.
hooks.eggplant-fries: Eggplant fries coated in panko and nori, fried golden and stacked high.
hooks.roasted-olives: Castelvetrano olives roasted with orange peel and Calabrian chili — buttery and spiced.
hooks.bread-butter: Smoky beef tallow whipped into butter, charred onion dust, served with sourdough.
hooks.oysters-1-2-dozen: East Coast oysters, ice-cold on a salt bed, with dill pickle granita, horseradish and lemon.
hooks.tuna-crudo: Salt-cured ahi over smoked tonnato, puttanesca punch, fried capers and mint.
hooks.wagyu-beef-carpaccio: Raw velvety Wagyu, mushroom vinaigrette, crispy parmesan frico, horseradish heat.
hooks.lamb-sausage: Wood-fire lamb sausage, garlic labneh, a fried egg, potato crunch.
hooks.burrata-cheese: Runny burrata, poached rhubarb, strawberry jam, charred sourdough.
hooks.grilled-octopus-salad: Octopus grilled over wood — braised, shaved fennel, orange-segment pop.
hooks.mushrooms-on-toast: Mushroom parfait on toast crowned with black truffle silk.
hooks.spiced-beet-salad: Spiced beets on whipped feta, pickled shallots, pistachio and dill.
hooks.endive: Endive, apple vinaigrette, Fontina layers, toasted pecan crunch.
hooks.crispy-smashed-potatoes: Crispy smashed potatoes, charred shallot aioli, Avonlea cheddar finish.
hooks.wood-grilled-asparagus: Wood-grilled charred asparagus topped with crab and vadouvan cream.
hooks.snap-peas: Spicy 'nduja dressing, shaved fennel, pecorino, crispy bacon gremolata.
hooks.smashed-cucumbers: Smashed cukes meet green tahini, toasted almond, chili heat.
hooks.bibb-lettuce: Crisp bibb in jalapeño cream with puffed grains and alpine cheese crunch.
hooks.margherita: Pizza dough, tomato sauce, fior di latte and basil — wood-fired classic.
hooks.chicken-sausage: No-red-sauce pie on garlic béchamel — provolone, bacon, pickled jalapeño, chicken sausage.
hooks.five-cheese: Five cheeses — fior di latte, fontina, oka, parmesan, provolone — over garlic béchamel.
hooks.fennel-salami: Fennel salami pie: shaved onion, Calabrian chili heat, caramelized honey, basil.
hooks.italian-sausage: Italian sausage with confit garlic, charred kale, pecorino crunch.
hooks.italian-pork-sausage: Spinach conchiglie with house pork sausage, shallot, garlic, white wine, Calabrian chili.
hooks.ricotta-dumplings: Ricotta dumplings, light as clouds, in vodka tomato sauce with basil.
hooks.shrimp-crab: Linguini in brown butter with shrimp, crab and chili.
hooks.bigoli: Bigoli in pomodoro — crushed olive and caper bring the brine, parsley to finish.
hooks.rigatoni: Rigatoni with mushrooms, parmesan sauce, a black-gold whisper of truffle oil.
hooks.grilled-farm-chicken: Wood-grilled chicken sausage in dill gravy, golden fries anchor the plate.
hooks.maple-bbq-rainbow-trout: Steel Head trout, creamed kale, smoked potato puree.
hooks.wood-grilled-beef-strip-steak: Strip steak under béarnaise, charred shallot and mushrooms, pommes paillasson, wild mushroom jus.
hooks.wood-roasted-halibut: Wood-roasted halibut into crab butter, snap peas, leeks, brioche.
hooks.grilled-lamb-saddle: Lamb saddle on garlicky labneh with warm potato salad and mint.
hooks.wood-roasted-half-duck: Half duck roasted glossy, black garlic emulsion, turnips two ways.
hooks.26oz-wood-grilled-beef-ribeye: 26oz wood-grilled ribeye with creamy pomme aligot and green peppercorn bone marrow jus.
hooks.the-banana-pie: Salted pretzel crust cradles caramelized banana, coffee cream, Italian meringue, rum caramel.
hooks.apple-tatin: Apples slow-caramelized with warm spices, capped in puff pastry, armagnac cream alongside.
hooks.chocolate-pot-de-creme: Dark chocolate custard over sour cherry jam, salted chocolate caramel, cherry gelato.
